high_level_description: The image depicts the entrance to the Public Works Department building, which is painted in a striking red color. The architecture of the building features a mix of colonial and traditional styles, with arched windows and decorative elements on the facade. The structure has multiple levels, with a prominent central archway leading into the building. Above the main entrance, there are two large signs written in both Tamil and English. The top sign reads "பொது வேலை துறை" (Pothu Vellai Thurai) in Tamil, which translates to "Public Works Department" in English.
